entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 8944 of 2021
Applicant :- Shoukeen

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Atul Kumar,Rajesh Kumar Yadav,S.M.Faraz I. Kazmi,Shams Uz Zaman
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Shyam Shamshery,J.
1.

Applicant has approached this Court by way of filing present bail application seeking enlargement
on bail in Case Crime No. 1222 of 2019 under Sections 498A, 304-B Ipc and 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police
Station- Barout, District- Baghpat.
2.
This bail application is pending before Court for last about three years.
S/Sri Atul Kumar,Rajesh Kumar Yadav,S.M.Faraz I. Kazmi,Shams Uz Zaman, learned counsel for applicant are not present and present status of trial is also not on record.
3. This Court finds that in some of cases Advocates are not appearing possibly on ground that they have no instructions or nothing survives in the matter.

However, being an Advocate and Officer of Court, they are under legal obligation to appear before Court and assist, whether they have received Shoukeen vs State Of U.P. on 14 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79894899/
1 proper instructions or not as the Vakalatnama filed by them has put them under solemn duty to appear before Court.
4.

entities.text: Shoukeen vs State Of U.P. on 14 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Sri D.P.S. Chauhan, learned AGA appearing for State, submits that applicant, who is in jail since 11.12.2020, is facing trial for offence under Sections 498A, 304-B IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act.

However,
present status of trial is not on record.

5. In aforesaid circumstances, taking note of evidence against applicant and that present status of trial is not on record and also that applicant is in jail since 11.12.2020, therefore, even in absence of counsel for applicant, in the interest of justice, this application is disposed of with observation that in case trial is not concluded till date, applicant will have liberty to approach this Court or Trial Court concerned, as advised, afresh alongwith status of trial.
Meanwhile, Trial Court shall take all endeavour to conclude trial.
6. A copy of this order be communicated to applicant through Jail Superintendent concerned.

Order Date :- 14.5.2024 P. Pandey  Shoukeen vs State Of U.P. on 14 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79894899/
